name: iron-throne-emerald
description: A Game of Thrones flavoured, Pokemon Emerald style monster-collecting RPG that runs entirely in the browser.

scripts.drivers: for d in thechain thecounter thedragon thedraw thefates theforge themenu pastfifty thefind therelic lastact comeback scenegates theeast thehall thelamp thelarder theopening thering theseats theshingle theswitch thewear thewinter; do node tools/$d.mjs > /dev/null || { echo "BAD $d"; exit 1; }; echo "ok  $d"; done
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run validate && node tools/checkmaps.mjs && node tools/checkstarts.mjs && npm run drivers
